ictal.A1: exact historical A1; frozen checkpoint; 5 fixed folds and 65 matched cells; target labels excluded from own epoch and beta selection
ictal.TF_fit: FIT patients only, patient-equal pathology BCE positive:negative=2:1, max 30 epochs, patient-equal validation AP
ictal.beta_selection: VLOO AP then MRR then Top1 then smaller beta; beta zero when no AP improvement

interictal.Nbase: independently train original A1-only v2 with original 112/29 split, AdamW lr=1e-4 wd=1e-3 batch=2 max_epochs=30, patient-equal AP selection, full-train refit, validation macro-F1 threshold
interictal.TF_fit: official train inner 112/29, patient-equal pathology BCE positive:negative=2:1, AdamW lr=1e-4 wd=1e-3 batch=2 max_epochs=30, validation patient-equal AP selection, all-train refit selected epochs
interictal.beta_selection: validation AUROC and patient-equal AP each >= beta0 minus 0.002; maximize validation macro-F1; then pathological F1, BA and threshold proximity to 0.5
interictal.evaluation: one frozen official-test scoring, 10000 patient-cluster paired bootstrap

TF.input: exact prior 32-bin 1-120Hz log-power STFT, 2s windows, 1s hop, 59 windows; train-only per-bin normalization
TF.encoder: TimeFrequencyEncoder from v1: 32->64 spectral and 4 gated depthwise residual temporal blocks dilation 1,2,4,8
TF.head: Linear(128,64)-GELU-Dropout(0.1)-Linear(64,1)

fusion.score: m_final=m_A1+beta*z_TF where z_TF is within-patient robust normalized TF margin

caveat: The shared topology is TF scorer/fusion; A1 training differs: ictal A1 is frozen historical while Omni A1-only is retrained. Hence the claim that reference operator is the only benchmark difference is not literally true.
